lines.text: Peter tells them to set their hope fully on the grace coming at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
Peter says to be holy in all they do, because the One who called them is holy.
Peter says they were redeemed with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish, not with silver or iron.
Christ was known before the foundation of the world but was revealed in the days of Moses for their sake.
Peter says they were born again through the living and enduring word of God, which stands forever.
